parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Method 1 (number of ways with no restriction on Es minus ways with Es together): $\frac{7!}{2!2!}-\frac{6!}{2!}$, $[=1260-360]$. First M1 guidance: $\frac{7!}{2!2!}-r$, where $r$ is an integer $>1$. Second M1 guidance: $s-\frac{6!}{2!}$, where $s$ is an integer $>360$. $=900$ (A1). Method 2 ($T\,\hat{}\,\hat{}\,\hat{}\,\hat{}\,\hat{}\,T$ with Es inserted in gaps): $\frac{5!}{2!}\times\frac{6\times5}{2}$ or $\frac{5!}{2!}\times{6\choose2}$, $[=60\times15]$. First M1 guidance: $t\times\frac{6\times5}{2}$ or $t\times{6\choose2}$, where $t$ is an integer $>1$. Second M1 guidance: $\frac{5!}{2!}\times u$, where $u$ is an integer $>1$. $=900$ (A1). Total: 3.

parts.label: (c)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Method 1 - addition: one E and exactly one T, ${2\choose1}{2\choose1}{5\choose2}=40$ (B1); two Es and exactly one T, ${2\choose1}{2\choose2}{5\choose1}=10$ (B1). For each B1, guidance: either identified or a correct unsimplified expression, either alone or in an addition. Probability $=\frac{40+10}{{9\choose4}}$ (M1). Guidance: $\frac{a}{{9\choose4}}$, where $a$ is an integer $<126$; denominator value must be seen as ${9\choose4}$ somewhere. $[\text{Percentage}=\frac{50}{126}\times100]=39.7\%$ (A1), with $39.68\le\text{percentage}\le39.7$. Method 2 - subtraction (total selections with 1 T minus selections with 1 T and 0 E): ${2\choose1}{7\choose3}=70$ (B1); ${2\choose1}{5\choose3}=20$ (B1). For each B1, guidance: either identified or a correct unsimplified expression, either alone or in a subtraction. Probability $=\frac{70-20}{{9\choose4}}$ (M1). Guidance: $\frac{a}{{9\choose4}}$, where $a$ is an integer $<126$; denominator value must be seen as ${9\choose4}$ somewhere. $[\text{Percentage}=\frac{50}{126}\times100]=39.7\%$ (A1), with $39.68\le\text{percentage}\le39.7$. Total: 4.
